Job Description

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs). The candidate will work on LLM-based solutions, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, AI integrations, and production-ready Generative AI applications.

Professional Skills

Strong Python programming skills.
Good understanding of Generative AI and LLMs.
Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering.
Experience with RAG and embeddings.
Knowledge of Vector Databases such as FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, or pgvector.
